evidence_boundary: Research registry only. A family is not a finding until its lane-specific promotion gate passes on frozen validation scenarios.
core_rule: No geometry is sacred until it wins. Every pattern must compete. Every champion must be frozen. Every claim must be measurable.

families.label: Mycelium or fungus network
families.natural_logic: redundant nutrient-seeking network with local repair and load sharing
families.benchmark_hypothesis: Test whether decentralized redundancy improves delivery and recovery under edge failures versus shortest-path and min-cost-flow baselines.
families.failure_mode: Can overbuild redundant paths, increasing cost and message load when failures are rare.
families.located_result: Negative portfolio result; ranked last in V2, V3, and V4. No routing implementation.

families.label: Slime mold routing
families.benchmark_hypothesis: Test adaptive shortest path under edge failures against Dijkstra and min-cost flow.
families.failure_mode: Can over-explore and create slow convergence under sparse reward.

families.label: Magnetic field geometry
families.benchmark_hypothesis: Test collision-aware guidance in attractor/repulsor fields.
families.failure_mode: Can get trapped in local minima.

families.label: Toroidal fields
families.natural_logic: closed-loop circulating field geometry with bounded recirculation
families.benchmark_hypothesis: Test whether toroidal attractor fields improve containment and recapture in cyclic control tasks versus Euclidean potential fields and MPC.
families.failure_mode: Can trap agents in stable loops and reduce goal progress when the task requires direct escape trajectories.

families.label: Halbach arrays
families.benchmark_hypothesis: Test asymmetric control fields for one-sided guidance.
families.failure_mode: Can be brittle when target orientation changes.

families.label: Flower of Life or hexagonal packing
families.natural_logic: dense local packing with redundant adjacency
families.benchmark_hypothesis: Test layout density and fault tolerance versus square/triangular/random packing.
families.failure_mode: Can be visually appealing but not task-optimal.

families.label: Non-Euclidean geodesics
families.natural_logic: curved-space shortest paths through constrained terrain
families.benchmark_hypothesis: Test routing on obstacle manifolds versus Euclidean A*.
families.failure_mode: Can add complexity without reducing real cost.

families.label: Frobenius stability tests
families.natural_logic: local series-expansion stability bound for detecting fragile operating regions
families.benchmark_hypothesis: Test whether Frobenius-style local stability diagnostics identify perturbation-sensitive windows before replay failure.
families.failure_mode: Can reject useful candidates if the local expansion is too conservative or poorly conditioned.

families.label: Bee foraging or waggle-routing paths
families.benchmark_hypothesis: Test target discovery when rewards move and bandwidth is limited.
families.failure_mode: Can overweight early noisy discoveries.

families.label: Bird V-formation or flocking

families.failure_mode: Can fail in cluttered environments.

families.label: Wolf-pack pursuit or encirclement paths

families.failure_mode: Can over-coordinate and waste messages.

families.label: Ant trails

families.label: River deltas

families.label: Leaf veins

families.label: Vascular or lung branching

families.label: Hibernation or bounded wake logic
